description: This PHP class defines 'Zend_XmlRpc_Value_String', which represents a string value in the XML-RPC protocol within the Zend Framework. It extends a scalar value class and provides methods to set and retrieve the string value, ensuring proper type and XML encoding.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_String
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC string value in the Zend Framework, providing constructor and method to access the string value.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a string value, setting the internal type and ensuring the value is a proper string.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value stored in the object, cast to a PHP string.
